pathway.title: Ares Capital historical capacity challenge
pathway.question: Does the published cushion prove financing access?

cells.text: View: Positive historical coverage and reported conditional funding rebut immediate funding closure, but do not establish an executable incremental-debt buffer. Retain a documentary-follow-up and monitoring posture: the favorable historical comparison survives; usable dollar capacity requires more evidence. This fresh sol-medium execution, dated 2026-11-05, consumes the exact current CP-4 capacity handoff and historical focused CP-0/CP-1/legal CP-4 for Ares Capital Corporation at 2024-12-31, focusing on the 5.950% notes due July 15, 2029. Run: sol-remaining-arcc-capacity-challenge-20261105; method deploy-v-r14; pathway covenant_refinancing. This is focused consumer proof, not a full CP-6 gate, eleven-step debate, committee decision, current underwriting or whole-pathway execution. No independent agents or separate debate roles were run.

rows.label: Reported facilities are material counterevidence to closure

cells.text: A88: approximately USD5.1bn conditional availability; A276: USD3,348m revolver availability
USD3,348m is included, not additive; USD2,219m ceiling difference from A274–275 is conditional expansion, not cash. Borrowing base/equity/other conditions can bind
Reported access survives; unconditional drawability does not
Reconcile conditions; never sum the three figures

rows.label: The 1.5 minima establish the same headroom and breach timing

cells.text: A276 reports facility maintenance and material compliance at December 31; B p20 §10.07/L1384–1385 incorporates Act restriction

Facility definitions/exceptions differ from note incurrence. B p12 §5.01(vii)/L917 uses below 100% at each last business day for 24 consecutive months; S pp2–3 §4.03/L216–217 separately requires 60 consecutive days after specified notice
Same-number equivalence rejected; dated issuer compliance assertion retained
Neither immediate default nor a general two-year cure follows

rows.label: January issuance and February authorization demonstrate extra resources or leakage

cells.text: A300: January 2025 USD1,000m gross new debt; A300–301: February extension of up-to-USD1,000m repurchase authority
Issuance demonstrates subsequent execution, not net retained cash; authorization is not actual repurchase, remaining RP capacity or December usage
Access evidence survives; December/pro-forma use inference rejected
Separate events; obtain proceeds/use and actual execution
Inherited S pp2–3 §2.01/Article Six: 100% principal plus accrued unpaid interest
Requires defined control change plus qualifying below-investment-grade event involving all three agencies, attribution/window and exceptions; not unconditional cash or recovery
Contingent protection only
Do not use as recovery floor or TDG-style 101% term

rows.label: Further secured funding automatically creates new priming

cells.text: A276 documents collateral, exclusions and base restrictions; A88 contemplates additional debt

Excludes investments held by Ares Capital CP, ACJB, AFB, ADL CLO 1/4 and others; consolidated value is not direct creditor reach. New secured claims depend on permissions, collateral and actual execution
Priority sensitivity survives; automatic transaction/amount rejected
Obtain entity/collateral map before unsecured recovery or priming claims

The strongest bear pathway is portfolio marks and funded uses → weaker adjusted coverage and/or borrowing base → constrained funding before payment default. Cash-funded returns remove assets; debt-funded uses also change senior claims. Restrictions could force asset sales, repayment or equity funding. This is an analyst stress mechanism, not an observed breach, quantified shock or prediction of default.

The strongest rebuttal is substantive: published 1.962x exceeds 1.5x; A88 reports USD635m cash and substantial conditional facilities; A276 asserts material facility compliance; January 2025 issuance demonstrates capital-market execution. This defeats an unsupported immediate-closure thesis. It does not prove that intended draws remain executable after uses, marks, equity requirements and collateral eligibility. Thus historical flexibility survives; exact usable incremental debt and RP capacity remain unresolved. No trade, size, present compliance or recovery estimate follows.
Pair next disclosure with unrounded pro-forma borrowing certificate
Verified surviving cushion after intended uses strengthens executable-buffer case; erosion tightens follow-up
Reconcile base eligibility, actual maintenance ratio, equity and lender commitments
Demonstrated drawable funding supports flexibility; failed conditions elevate funding-constraint concern
Track actual draws, repurchases, collateral changes and proceeds location
Documented outflows/new secured claims warrant renewed capacity and priority analysis, not assumed leakage
Obtain notices, monthly coverage history, consents and defeasance records
Evaluate the applicable trigger only when its conditions/history are evidenced
